prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: uart-tx-div
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): c0ee51dd8f616bad
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback RX got 0xff (idle) instead of 0xa5, so ser_tx never presented correct start/data bits. TX bit-advance on line 130 uses (cfg_divider >> 4) - the 16x RX oversample tick - instead of full cfg_divider. With divider 64 TX shifts every ~5 cycles vs 64 expected, so the peer samples idle and the transfer fails.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash c0ee51dd8f616bad in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
